description:
Logan’s past refuses to stay buried in Wolverine, a brutal new Marvel action cinematic built around rage, bloodshed, and the tortured man behind the adamantium claws.

Haunted by fragments of a life he can barely remember, Wolverine begins a relentless search for answers that takes him from the frozen wilderness of Canada to the streets of Tokyo and the dangerous island of Madripoor. But every secret pulls him deeper into a violent conspiracy filled with mutant hunters, cybernetic killers, and familiar enemies determined to turn Logan back into the weapon he once was.

With Mystique, Omega Red, the Reavers, and other powerful forces closing in, Logan must unleash the beast within and carve his way through anyone standing between him and the truth. Fast, savage, and emotionally charged, Wolverine delivers a darker Marvel story driven by revenge, survival, and one man’s fight to reclaim his identity.

Experience the official trailer in 4K and witness Wolverine at his most ferocious.
